title: CellPlex: Benchmarking Single-Cell Spatial Proteomics Prediction from H&E
reasons: 摘要级证据不足以自动收录，保留材料等待补充

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce CellPlex, a benchmark that poses the task at the level of the cell: seven cohorts with same-section H\&E and multiplexed immunofluorescence, from colorectal and breast cancer to lymph-node metastases, bone marrow and glioma, with 717 samples, 44.8 million cells and 149 proteins, processed by one pipeline into per-cell targets.

evidence.excerpt: Each is evaluated on its own cohort, panel and pixel-level metric, and released models transfer poorly to new cohorts, leaving open which approach to build on and which proteins H\&E can reveal.
